Card Q&A.a: No, you can't activate it. If you don't perform the action specified for "by X" in such an effect, the rest of the effect won't activate.
Card Q&A.q: Can I activate the "if a Tamer card with the [SoC] trait is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, " effect in this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect even if I don't perform "by trashing 1 card in your hand, this Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn"?

Effect: [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] By trashing 1 card in your hand, this Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn. If a Tamer card with the [SoC] trait is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, ＜Draw 1＞.
